cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_ameth: Replaces a projectile with a native amethyst cluster. Retains native impact particles and sounds. Amplify changes damage as for Harm.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_lionf: Replaces a projectile with a native lionfish spike. Successful hits retain native Poison I for 3 seconds. Amplify changes direct damage as for Harm.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_bolt_: Summons a native lightning column at the selected location after a short delay. Amplify changes damage as for Harm.
cataclysm_nouveau.augment.increase_damag: Increase each hit from its unaugmented base by a bounded percentage.
cataclysm_nouveau.augment.decrease_damag: Decrease each hit from its unaugmented base by a bounded percentage.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_void_: Raises a native Void Rune on nearby ground at the selected location, retaining its attack animation and damage timing. Amplify increases each hit by the same amount as Harm.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_flame: Erupts a native Flame Jet from nearby ground at the selected location. Retains native particles, sound and five-second ignition. Amplify increases direct damage by the same amount as Harm.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_cerau: Replace the projectile with Ceraunus. A single throw returns after impact; repeating carriers retain their trajectory.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_wave: Replace a projectile with a wave that pushes enemies, extinguishes fire and applies Wetness. Lasts four seconds by default; Extend Time increases its duration.
cataclysm_nouveau.validation.modifier: This modifier requires a compatible projectile replacement.
cataclysm_nouveau.augment.wave_duration_: Increases a native wave's duration by 50% of its base duration. Repeating carriers follow their own duration.
Decreases a native wave's duration by 50% of its base duration. Repeating carriers follow their own duration.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_flare: Replaces a projectile with the Netherite Monstrosity's Flare Bomb. On impact, native flame jets spread outward in a cross. Amplify increases both direct and jet damage as for Harm.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_lava_: Launches the Monstrosity's lava bomb. Explodes on impact and leaves a temporary, non-spreading lava source.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_earth: Strikes and launches enemies around the resolved location, including the Boss's health-based damage. Ignites targets when the caster is at or below half health.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_fissu: Sends a widening ground shockwave forward from the resolved location, lifting visual debris and knocking enemies back.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_flame: Creates the Boss's paired expanding flame rings at the resolved location. At half health or below, the caster produces larger, denser rings.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_shoul: Charges toward the selected direction, knocking enemies back and inflicting Bone Fracture. Stops at obstacles. Allied entity targets perform the charge themselves. Can also execute at a block hit along the incoming direction without moving the caster.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_lava_: Absorbs lava around the resolved location in three expanding waves. Each wave that consumes lava heals the caster.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_monst: Grants an ally Monstrous: increased armor, toughness and knockback resistance, with periodic healing below half health.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_bone_: Fracture an enemy, reducing movement and attack speed. Lasts 5 seconds; Amplify increases the effect level and Extend Time increases duration.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_lava_: Let an ally walk on lava and resist lava and lingering burning damage for 30 seconds. Crouch to dive.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_water: Replaces the projectile with a native water spear. Base damage 14; successful hits stack Wetness for 10 seconds. Native flight retains eight bounces; Ars carriers control recurring trajectories.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_light: Replaces the projectile with a native lightning spear. Base damage 14; block impacts create a lightning strike and shrinking electric field, with native arcs and animation.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_storm: Manifests two storm serpents near the selected location. They aim, then strike for 16 damage each and apply Wetness V for 7.5 seconds before fading.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_light: Calls a native lightning storm at the selected ground position. Base damage 10 plus 4% of the target maximum health. Amplify increases base damage.
Leaves a native electric field with rain fog and arcs at the selected ground position. Base damage 4; lasts 8 seconds and gradually shrinks. Duration augments change its lifetime.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_storm: Unleashes Scylla's native stormburst at the selected ground position: 35 delayed lightning strikes along seven spokes, accompanied by two electric sparks that leave fields on landing.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_spark: Replaces the projectile with an arcing electric spark and native lightning trail. Landing creates a lightning strike and shrinking field; the spark itself has no direct entity damage.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_light: Calls two rows of nine lightning strikes. Entity targets retain native movement prediction; location targets use the trigger direction to orient the rows. Subsequent effects proceed normally.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_thund: Forms a thundercloud above the selected location. After a default two-second formation period, rains native water and lightning spears with bounces, Wetness and landing fields. Duration augments affect the rain interval.

An allied recipient performs two frontal strikes with sixteen sparks each, and a five-spear fan between them. Native damage, shield breaking and landing effects are retained; payment and damage credit belong to the caster. Can also execute at a block hit along the incoming direction without moving the caster.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_ancho: An allied recipient performs three surrounding strikes with native shield breaking and knockback. Damage uses the Boss baseline; Amplify increases each hit. Can also execute at a block hit along the incoming direction without moving the caster.

Leap yourself or an ally, then throw a straight hook along the current aim and pull towards its impact. Landing triggers a native storm burst. Airborne allies can also act; an unhit hook cannot pull. Can also execute at a block hit along the incoming direction without moving the caster.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_water: Grants an ally Water Walking for 30 seconds. The surface counts as ground, jumping is preserved, and crouching allows diving. Duration augments modify the lifetime.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_laser: Replace a projectile with the Harbinger’s native laser bolt. Ignites hit enemies; acceleration changes launch speed.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_withe: Replace a projectile with an explosive wither missile. Retains native withering and healing on a lethal direct hit.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_homin: Replace a projectile with a native homing missile. Ordinary shots acquire a visible enemy ahead; Ars trajectory forms retain their own movement.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_withe: Replace a projectile with an explosive shell that leaves a shrinking wither smoke cloud.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_death: Channel the Harbinger’s native piercing beam for 3 seconds after a brief windup. Consumes mana each active second. Below or at half health, the caster adds the native ignition effect. Amplify increases damage; duration augments change channel duration.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_harbi: The caster or an ally charges along their aim, colliding with enemies. Retains native impact damage and knockback; at half health, the native chance of consecutive charges applies. Can also execute at a block hit along the incoming direction without moving the caster.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_howit: Fire two native arcing howitzer volleys, five shells each; seven each at half health. Shells retain their explosions and wither smoke.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_missi: Lock a visible enemy and fire six native homing missiles. At half health, the launchers fire together in a faster sequence.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_withe: Create a shrinking cloud of native wither smoke at the trigger position. Duration augments change its lifetime.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_guard: Replace a projectile with a Guardian bullet that prepares before accelerating along a fixed direction. Hits deal damage and 5 seconds of Levitation; special forms retain their own trajectory.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_void_: Create a grounded vortex that pulls enemies above it inward and downward, then explodes on collapse. Base duration is 15 seconds; duration augments change its lifetime.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_guard: After a short windup, form three rings of Void Runes and one to three rows along the trigger direction. At or below half health when cast, perform three consecutive stomps.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_gravi: The caster or a selected ally pulls nearby enemies in front before delivering a native shield-disabling heavy punch. Amplify increases damage. Can also execute at a block hit along the incoming direction without moving the caster.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_guard: Self or an ally lunges into an uppercut, lifting and stunning enemies before deploying nine prepared Guardian bullets. At half caster health, adds a heavy strike and a fan of Void Runes. Can also execute at a block hit along the incoming direction without moving the caster.

Self or an ally predicts an enemy position, safely blinks there, then strikes with lift, stun and shield break. Entity movement requires an enemy found from the executor's view. Can also execute at a block hit along the incoming direction without moving the caster; target and safe-destination requirements apply only to entity movement. Hostile entity hits fail rather than redirecting the action to the caster.

Self or an ally teleports above an enemy, then releases a shockwave and radial Void Runes only after landing. Half caster health increases the drop height. Requires an enemy entity and clear space. Can also execute at a block hit along the incoming direction without moving the caster; target and safe-destination requirements apply only to entity movement.

Self or an ally dashes horizontally toward a target, then punches with knockback and shield break. Entity movement follows the executor's aim. Can also execute at a block hit along the incoming direction without moving the caster. Hostile entity hits fail rather than redirecting the action to the caster.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_ignis: Replaces the projectile with an Ignis fireball, retaining native trail, explosion, stacking Blazing Brand and 5 health restored on a successful hit. At two-thirds caster health or below, uses soul fire.
Replaces the projectile with an Abyss fireball, preserving wall bounces, native explosion, health-based damage, Blazing Brand and healing. Special Ars forms retain their own trajectory.
Deploys three native Ignis fireballs with their staggered preparation and synchronized release. Preserves target correction on release and 40 ticks later; the group pays once.

The caster or an ally leaps and smashes upon actually landing, followed by four ground shockwaves. Block hits perform the preparation and impact at the fixed point without moving the caster. Retains native damage, launch and shield disable without terrain destruction.

Self or an ally performs both sword-dance phases, steering between strikes and locking direction during swings. On a block hit, a phantom performs the dance at that fixed position and heading without moving the caster. Hits stack Blazing Brand and heal the caster; the group pays once.
Prepare four normal or soul fireballs and one Abyss fireball at the resolved location, launching in sequence with native explosions, brand and healing.

The caster, an ally or a fixed point performs three heavy strikes with native ground shockwaves, ignition, Blazing Brand and hit healing. Entity actions can turn between strikes and lock their heading during attacks.

The caster or an ally performs two swings and three blade fireballs before leaping. Actual landing triggers the reinforced smash, ground waves and three more fireballs, including one Abyss fireball. Block hits perform these attacks at a fixed point without moving the caster.

The caster, an ally or a fixed point prepares a heavy forward slash, ground shockwaves and eight flame fields. Entity actions can turn during preparation and lock heading for the slash. Retains the native opening ring, lingering flames, Blazing Brand and ending explosions.
Raise a grounded flame field that periodically damages enemies and stacks Blazing Brand. Base duration is 3 seconds before time augments; normal flame explodes on expiry, soul flame does not.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_phant: Replaces the projectile with a native seeking phantom arrow. Cursed Rage adds 5% base damage per level, up to five. Preserves native trails and impact effects.
Raises a native phantom halberd at nearby ground. Preserves its delayed multi-hit window, armor and shield bypass. Cursed Rage adds 10% base damage per level, up to five.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_curse: Adds one level of rage to yourself or an ally, up to five. Amplify adds levels. Each level decays after ten seconds without refreshing. Only Maledictus abilities benefit.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_phant: Creates the native two-part spiral formation around nearby ground. Each halberd retains native damage and benefits from Cursed Rage. The formation pays once.
Raises two rings of native halberds. At half and quarter caster health, further rings appear. Each halberd benefits from Cursed Rage; the formation pays once.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_halbe: You or an ally perform two native halberd strikes followed by an advancing fan of halberds. Successful melee hits build Cursed Rage. Also supports a fixed position and incoming direction.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_soul_: Prepares a native soul explosion at the resolved position. Clears the caster's Cursed Rage when the strike occurs, before computing damage.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_maled: Leaps and dives, then performs two native landing impacts and spiral/ring halberd formations. Preserves native damage, rage and low-health rings. Supports self, ally or a position phantom.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_phant: Ascends, hovers and fires four native homing phantom arrows before landing. Preserves rage scaling; the whole action pays once.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_maled: Backsteps and rushes forward. Half caster health adds a second rush; quarter health adds a third. Successful native hits build Cursed Rage.
Smashes the ground, then sends successive native damage waves outward, preserving damage, knock-up and rage.
Performs two native uppercuts, with first-hit launch, shield breaking and Cursed Rage.
Performs two native melee strikes. A successful second strike enables a follow-up combo; otherwise recovers. Preserves native damage, shield breaking and rage.
Lunges forward for two native spinning slashes. The second strike breaks shields. Preserves native damage and Cursed Rage, with steering during preparation windows.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_abyss: Replaces the projectile with a native Abyss Orb. Delayed homing, explosions and purple arcs are preserved. Successful direct hits briefly prevent healing with Abyssal Fear; young orbs do not immediately explode on blocks.
Places a floating native mine at the impact. After arming, an enemy triggers its explosion and Abyssal Fear. Expiry does not detonate it. Duration augments change its lifetime.

The caster or an ally emits the native beam along their view, or it fires from a fixed position. One-second preparation and four seconds of output, prepaid per active second; insufficient mana stops it. Successful hits stack Abyssal Burn, which may teleport low-health victims.
Opens a native ground portal which then fires an upward beam for eight seconds, inflicting Abyssal Burn. Duration augments extend the beam. Its price includes the portal and child beam.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_dimen: Opens a growing native rift at the impact, pulling nearby enemies and objects, dealing contact damage and collapsing in an explosion. Preserves native stages and closing; terrain lifting is disabled. Duration augments change its lifespan.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_tidal: Launches the native claw tentacle at a visible hostile living target within 16 blocks. Chains, stacks Abyssal Curse and retracts. Shares the native claw single-chain gate; one payment covers all links.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_abyss: After native preparation, distributes up to 35 floating mines around the impact or target with staggered arming. Obstructions and unloaded terrain reduce the count. One payment covers the field; duration augments extend the mines.

After preparation, opens random surrounding portals and performs three aimed upward bombardments. Preserves native ground search and timing, with up to 12 portals. One payment includes the array and child beams.

After a short preparation, releases the native three-layer array of 12 Abyss Orbs, or five layers of 24 if the caster starts at half health or less. Preserves delayed homing, explosions and healing prevention. Emits from self or allied eyes, or a fixed block impact. Pay once for the entire array.

Releases three native abyssal rays with separate aiming and locking windows. Emits from self or allied eyes, or a fixed impact and direction. Duration augments change each ray's active time. Prepay each active second of each ray; insufficient mana stops the entire remaining sequence.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_sands: Summons three native sandstorms around yourself, an ally, or a fixed point for 15 seconds. Contact damages enemies and applies Curse of the Desert. Duration augments change their lifetime.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_deser: Forms a native stele above the selected location. After a brief warning it falls, piercing enemies and causing a small landing impact with Curse of the Desert.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_groun: Replaces the projectile with a ground-travelling quake that damages and knocks back grounded enemies. Entity-hit follow-up effects require successful damage and continue only once per enemy for each wave.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_remna: Sends a widening ground shockwave forward from the casting location, raising blocks and striking enemies. Damage and the additional maximum-health term follow Ancient Remnant stomps. At or below half health, the original caster produces a double stomp instead.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_deser: Calls the complete native eight-arm stele formation and a line aimed forward. Steles fall in sequence, retaining piercing, landing impacts and Curse of the Desert. The entire array pays once.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_remna: Performs three native ground slams, each releasing 22–29 quake waves in all directions. Direct slams, native ground-target damage and knockback are retained. The sequence pays once.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_curse: Replaces the projectile with a native cursed sandstorm that starts homing after a short delay. A normal shot can deal damage twice before fading. Repeating forms pay each accepted contact and retain their Ars trajectory.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_remna: The executor prepares, then charges forward with native contact damage and knockback. Supports self, allies and positions; stops at walls without breaking terrain.
Sweep a Remnant tail ahead of self, an ally or a selected position, retaining native damage, knockback, shield disable and stun.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_ashen: Emit the native growing ash cone from self, an ally or a position, dealing magic damage and blindness. Pays mana for each active second.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_blazi: Replace a projectile with a spinning Blazing Bone, retaining its native gravity and impact fragments.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_bone_: Release four native radial volleys from self, an ally or a position. Each volley randomly fires six, eight or ten Blazing Bones.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_axe_b: Replace a projectile with an Aptrgangr axe blade. It pierces entities and blocks before fading away.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_aptrg: Perform a native Aptrgangr smash from self, an ally or a position, striking ahead and releasing five axe blades.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_berse: Perform two native cross slashes. Successful hits stack Blazing Brand and restore health.
Perform one of the native four-strike advancing sword dances. Successful hits stack Blazing Brand and restore health.
Prepare, spin with both blades, then recover. Native repeated contact damage pushes enemies away.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_abyss: Marks an enemy with a pursuing abyssal sigil. After four seconds it becomes an abyssal beam portal. Duration augments change the beam duration.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_pries: Self, an ally, or a selected location emits a deepling priest's glare. Nearby enemies looking directly at the unobstructed glare are damaged and blinded.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_void_: Replaces the projectile with a void howitzer shell. Its explosion raises expanding rings of void runes. A direct killing blow heals its owner.
Replaces the projectile with a void scatter arrow. Impact releases void shards which exclude the arrow's initial victim.
